verdict.rationale: The only evidence is the `npm create cloudflare@latest my-app` scaffolding command, plus a claim that full-stack apps can be built with many frameworks. This suggests a first-party starter or project generator, but the evidence never describes a template catalog, use-case starters or a one-click deploy flow. API token templates are a different feature and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented template/starter gallery for common use cases, one-click deploy buttons or a dashboard flow, framework-specific starter details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: Build full-stack apps with your framework of choice, including React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router, and more
